description: Report a match result (organizer step 5, on match day; needs manage_code). Recording a score advances the winner into the next round automatically and returns where they advanced to. Pass undo=true with the match_id to revert a result (cascades to auto-filled downstream slots); pass undo_preview=true together with undo=true to first see — without writing anything — what the undo would clear downstream and whether a downstream result currently blocks it. Overwriting an existing result is logged as a correction. Consistency is enforced whenever score_sets are provided: the sets must produce the declared winner, and the text score must match the sets set-for-set written p1-first (e.g. '6-4 6-3'); a contradictory combination — or a text score that cannot be parsed for checking — is rejected and nothing is written. Optional safety: pass expect_winner and/or expect_score with the values you last read for this match (e.g. from get_bracket); if the stored result has since changed, the call is refused with a conflict error instead of overwriting the other referee's work.

expect_score.description: Optional guard: the score string you last read for this match. If the stored score differs, the call is refused with a conflict error.

expect_winner.description: Optional guard: the winner you last read for this match. If the stored winner differs, the call is refused with a conflict error.

match_id.description: e.g. M1 (the player page's label for the match; legacy R1M1-style ids are also accepted)

score_sets.description: Optional structured per-set scores, written in parallel with the display string `score` (the display string keeps its own semantics). Each item is an object {p1: integer, p2: integer, tb?: [integer, integer]}, e.g. [{"p1": 6, "p2": 4}, {"p1": 7, "p2": 6, "tb": [7, 5]}], where tb is the optional tie-break points [p1, p2]. Stored in the match object in the structured form DUPR reporting requires (required for rated events; the referee scoring UI blocks confirmation without it). NOTE: this server only stores the sets - it does not submit results to DUPR itself. Overwrite rules: passing a full array replaces the stored sets; passing an empty array [] clears them. If you overwrite with a CHANGED `score` string and omit score_sets, the previously stored sets are CLEARED (they would no longer match the new string) and the response includes a warning - re-report with score_sets to restore them. If the `score` string is unchanged, omitting score_sets leaves the stored sets untouched.

p1.description: points/games won by the player in slot p1 in this set

p2.description: points/games won by the player in slot p2 in this set

tb.description: optional tie-break score [p1, p2], exactly two integers

undo.description: Set true (with match_id; winner/score not needed) to revert that match's result and its downstream effects

undo_preview.description: With undo=true: return what the undo would clear (and what blocks it) WITHOUT writing anything

winner.description: exact player name as in the bracket (spelling must match)

name: report_result
